full_dataset_size: Whole repo is ~1.5 MB / ~50 files at HEAD: adds 15 more infotable XMLs (46-93 KB each), two EDGAR submissions JSONs for CIK 0001067983 (178 KB + 252 KB) and a 113 KB PNG. Only one filer (Berkshire). Regenerating for another CIK is one run of src/edgar_client.py against the free EDGAR API (User-Agent header only, no key).
description: Quarterly 13F-HR holdings of Berkshire Hathaway (CIK 0001067983), one row per CUSIP per report quarter, parsed from EDGAR infotable XML by a small Python puller that also records the filing date (~45 days after quarter end) and diffs consecutive quarters to produce mirror trades; plus a daily mirror-vs-SPY equity curve from a dry-run backtest. Source is SEC EDGAR (public domain data); the repo was created and pushed 3 Sep 2026 by a single author. For ABNB the holdings themselves are irrelevant (Berkshire holds no ABNB); the value is the point-in-time convention (report_date vs filing_date carried on every row) and the reusable edgar_client/parse_13f/diff code, which an analyst would re-point at ABNB's own 13F holder universe (or at any filer) to build a holder-concentration and turnover series aligned to filing dates rather than quarter ends.
issues: No LICENSE file in the repo (code reuse is a human decision; the underlying 13F data is SEC public domain so the data itself is unencumbered). Job card said 17 holdings files; the repo has 16 (2022-09-30 to 2026-06-30). Sample exceeded the ~10-file guideline because the plan explicitly asked for all 16 quarterly JSONs (each 6-10 KB); total is still 0.4 MB. cusip_ticker.json has 10 of 82 CUSIPs unmapped (null). Backtest touches Alpaca paper trading (.env.example lists API keys) - not run, nothing was logged into. Single filer only; nothing ABNB-specific.
